title: Ordinary direct-image evaluation transition square
statement: For a scheme morphism f : X ⟶ Y and an adjacent positive coefficient quotient, the direct-image/evaluation isomorphisms of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core] commute with the transitions of the coefficient sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], after the inverse of the normalized scalar comparison r of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. The normalization hypothesis identifies r with the inverse of the canonical identity-on-sections comparison of [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. This holds for every coefficient sequence module N on X.

source.place: Construction 4.1, sectionwise transition calculation preceding Lemma 4.10

proof.text: Use the direct evaluation unique characterization, which says that each comparison is identity on every underlying section.

The successor-arrow equation for Functor.ofOpSequence identifies the normalized quotient restriction with constant-coefficient scalar restriction. Transport the two restriction functors along this equality. The heterogeneous normalization of r then identifies r.inv with the coefficient comparison, which is identity on sections.

The coefficient transition is the presheaf restriction along the horizontal sequence arrow. The product base-change functor maps that arrow to the horizontal arrow at the base-changed object. Consequently the two composites agree on all sections; module-sheaf extensionality concludes. The same calculation covers n = 0 and zero modules.

theorem integralPullEvaluation_directTransitionSquare {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (r : normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
        proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 2)) ≅
      proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) ⋙
        normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n))
    (hr : HEq r (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison f
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionTransition l E (n + 1))).symm) :
    let d : pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n ≅
        coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n ⋙
          proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) :=
      pullbackTensorSequenceDirectEvaluation l E f n
    let d' : pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f ⋙
        coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y (n + 1) ≅
        coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X (n + 1) ⋙
          proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2)) :=
      pullbackTensorSequenceDirectEvaluation l E f (n + 1)
    ∀ N : coefficientSequenceModules l E X,
      (coefficientSequenceTransition l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)).app
          ((pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f).obj N) ≫
        (normalizedDVRModuleRes l E Y (Nat.le_succ n)).map (d.hom.app N) ≫
        r.inv.app ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).obj N) =
      d'.hom.app N ≫
        (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 2))).map
          ((coefficientSequenceTransition l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).app N)
